## Personality

Clair is a sensible and optimistic individual who communicates in a brief, direct manner. Though described as lacking much tact or imagination, he possesses a strong sense of patriotism and intends to pursue a career as a carpenter.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P10](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0010), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P13](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0013), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_
